title: dsh plugin contract for the proposer
audience: Proposer models and maintainers changing skills or plugin sources

claims.text: Plugins load as packages in a patch-composed Cordis tree; bundles declare dsh.bundle.patch entry rows with stable ids, and later layers restate rows with last-write-wins semantics.

Tools register through ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...)) with dsh's JSON-schema vocabulary (required: true, type json, oneOf, additionalProperties false); output is the canonical value and render is model-facing.

Session events form an append-only log; recorder plugins bind launcher-owned runtime state on session/created but do not trust the quarantined candidate helper's mutable in-process diagnostic service for eligibility. They subscribe to session/event, drain durably on awaited session/flush, and attempt contained final writes on observe-only session/disposed; projections store digests and counts, never raw arguments or results.

Proposals may target editable surfaces only; the evaluator, sealed holdout, permissions, budget, promotion policy, audit log, and rollback are immutable anchors, and profile mounting stays approval-gated.

Current DSH hmr/reload can precede replacement-Fiber readiness and cannot identify a multi-file imported closure. DAL therefore exposes inactive staging and diagnostic event sequencing only; application fails before approval verification or live writes, and no generation is admitted.

limits: Condensed for proposer context; the canonical source evidence is docs/research-evidence.md with pinned identities.
This capsule documents the inspected harness contract; runtime-composition evidence is tracked separately, and hmr/reload is not readiness or imported-closure proof.
